# Synthetic offline test fixtures

`ocr_once_scene.synthetic.json` contains invented process/window/session/path/time identities and representative physical geometry. It contains no account identifiers, chat text, screenshots, credentials or machine-specific runtime paths. It is test input, never runtime authorization or capture evidence.

The fixture exercises three individually bound technical errors, their native ancestor chains, the typed empty-native case, four strong-input proofs, unchanged strict rejection, and an 8-pixel owner superset intersecting the ROI in exactly 4 by 825 = 3300 pixels. It is independent of `experimental/accessibility-probe/scene-report.json` and is included with source tests.
